findings.text: follow-on: the fragment and the manifest quote the head SVG as 32,819 bytes, but the same tree and pipeline yield 51,648 bytes here (stable across runs); both satisfy the 100 KB bound so the done-when holds, yet the quoted metric does not reproduce and should have been re-read from the run rather than asserted.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit — bded8c1 the code and tests (+186/-4), 18bb10a the evidence fragment, 540f3be a base-arm count correction; the code matches the section, adding no other matplotlib code path.
item_verdicts.done_when: tests/unit/test_trace_resolution.py renders a 300,000-sample trace through time_trace_figure_mpl and render_to_bytes(format="svg") asserting the SVG is under 100 KB, asserts the altair renderer emits at most trace_max_points points with the global minimum and maximum intact, and asserts a 500-sample series is drawn unchanged; all three pass here, and the declared mutation reddens the SVG test.
item_verdicts.goal: the landed change bounds trace figures to display resolution — imas_ink/style.py:166 adds path_simplify_threshold (1.0) and trace_max_points (4000), imas_ink/io.py:48 saves inside an rc_context applying path.simplify with the style threshold, and imas_ink/alt.py:378 draws a series longer than the bound through the single min/max envelope in imas_ink/_decimate.py:14.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, every declared field filled, both gate logs recorded with identical failure-id sets, a negative control named with its log, and the two constants and their defaults recorded.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's seven declared paths; the diff over 596ad0f..540f3be touches exactly six (imas_ink/style.py, io.py, _decimate.py, alt.py, tests/unit/test_trace_resolution.py, docs/evidence/fragments/trace-figure-display-resolution/ink-trace-resolution.html) with no file outside the declaration; the declared figure directory is not written and the section requires no figure.

justifications.durability: each added assertion fails under a specific regression — test_long_trace_svg_is_bounded reddens when render_to_bytes ignores the threshold (shown), test_altair_bounds_long_series_but_keeps_extremes reddens if the envelope drops an extreme, and test_altair_keeps_short_series_unchanged reddens if a sub-limit series is binned (tests/unit/test_trace_resolution.py:36,44,52).
justifications.evidence: the reviewed manifest's baseline_suite (596ad0f) and after_suite (540f3be) logs both end '1 failed, 4 errors' with identical failure ids and the negative control reproduces exactly here (324,979 bytes, EXIT=1, only test_long_trace_svg_is_bounded reddens), but the fragment's quoted head SVG size (32,819 bytes, docs/evidence/fragments/trace-figure-display-resolution/ink-trace-resolution.html:26) does not reproduce — I measure 51,648 bytes stably, still under the 100 KB bound.
justifications.fit: the private module imas_ink/_decimate.py:1 and private function _minmax_envelope follow the repository's existing private-module idiom (_cocos.py, _compat.py), the InkStyle fields carry mechanism comments, and no plan label, version, ticket or author attribution appears in any changed path.
justifications.goal_fidelity: independently reproduced against the reviewed head — imas_ink/_decimate.py:40 bins into trace_max_points/2 equal-count bins returning min/max in time order, and imas_ink/io.py:48 applies path_simplify_threshold from style.path_simplify_threshold with no other matplotlib path.
justifications.reuse: a capability search over imas_ink for decimation, downsampling, resampling, envelope and min/max found no owner of a trace-envelope reducer (imas_ink/three_d/primitives.py:211 resamples a polyline by arc length for geometry sweeps, a different capability), so _minmax_envelope is the first owner and both renderers reach it without forking.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only over 596ad0f..540f3be lists exactly the six declared source/test/fragment paths and nothing outside the manifest's declared write paths.
